capabilities.local_comparison: Compare two local controller solves at the same saved state/previous input/horizon with exactly one adopted weight change. Measures local plan/endpoint differences; does not establish closed-loop settling or causal attribution. Requires a saved effective horizon matching the authorized horizon.
capabilities.prediction_braking: At one saved projected state, compare recorded input with instantaneous braking-box input over the fixed short horizon. Can measure local endpoint speed/position differences. Cannot separate objective weighting, seed selection, horizon effects or backend-model mismatch when they predict the same result; cannot identify the dominant settling cause.

design_response_content.reasoning:
Defer: I withhold any adopt/reject decision and adopt no parameter or configuration change; this response and the requested check execute nothing in production.

Evidence basis (retained, condition-level only): the settling/reach split is confirmed — sampled_settling_passed false (f843e37e38155) with terminal_speed_m_s 0.63517 (f418c926dd100) and late_max_speed_m_s 1.58102 (fa43ed5eabb06) above the 0.02 m/s settling limit (f1879a2c14c0f/fbffdd7291613) and late_max_error_m 0.05814 (f8c83b440fac2) above the 0.01 m position limit (fa53dbaae827b) over the 0.05 s window (f24aaf1e60926), while reach_passed true (f08522c007a4b) with terminal_error_m 0.00764 (fd5c05c603df2) under reach_tolerance_m 0.01 (fc6da63c54c1a).

All three candidates stay "possible"; none is established: (a) wall/optimizer degradation is real (deadline_misses 35 f1a8aca343a4c, mean_update_s 17.0752 vs control_period_s 0.01 fc3e07940a601, Solve_Succeeded 1 f9f57debcab06 vs User_Requested_Stop 34 f896c335d449f, max_cpu_s 30.0 fec8cb1d3c334) but the recorded scheduling note states wall misses do not inject physical delay into simulated time, so it is not a demonstrated mechanism; (b) plan selection is seed-heavy (initialization_selected 29 f07075cb85d67 vs noninitialization_selected 6 f8c54d6a0848c) with effective_horizon truncating to 2 then 1 control interval (fbfaabe26a4c6, fa9901287d4f1) against configured horizon 10 (fa189a4662e78), regenerate_warm_states true (fc06a9ca92440), feasible_return budget_s 15.0 (f2c8f1e1c85bc) / relative_improvement 0.1 (f9628753bdd0e); (c) terminal/holding tip-speed weights are 0.0 (fc17faf684175, f5fff06cc25a9, fbb12d12af8f1) with velocity_weight/terminal_velocity_weight 1e-4 (fa5ce81d0f133, f7e8dd095f223), tip_speed_scale_m_s 0.02 (fbe6184c4a727) and terminal_weight 5.0 (f02e51f762cfb), but raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance.

Binding limitations: no historical optimizer iterations or full warm plans (f4a5865f0cf67; source.historical_full_plans retained=false), single execution and model comparisons do not establish a dominant cause (fdfc7c5c90921), full_snapshots_available false (fd78b9eed95db), so plan-selection/warm-start and objective-weighting effects cannot be separated from the record and no root cause is claimed.

Next action request_check, independently: the host has now supplied the saved_state_or_temporary_analysis authorization the sensitivity-check recommendation awaited, so the defer's premise is satisfied and one bounded check should run. Request the single allowed check at one saved state whose recorded effective horizon matches the authorized horizon_s 0.01 (e.g., update 34, effective_horizon 1 interval fa9901287d4f1) — local_comparison with exactly one temporary change to terminal_tip_speed_weight (recorded 0.0), or equivalently prediction_braking at one saved projected state comparing recorded input with instantaneous braking-box input — reporting only local endpoint speed/position differences. Note source.saved_projected_states (35 records) and source.force_limits (6 channels, 8 N) were not read in this context. This 10 ms projected-model probe can measure local endpoint differences only; it cannot establish closed-loop settling or a dominant cause, and I will retain this disposition if the result is small or ambiguous.

instructions: Select one discriminating check based on unresolved hypotheses. Inspect retained evidence as needed to choose the operation and update_id. The host binds the chosen update's exact measured_initial_state and operation-defined input from the inventory controller file; do not copy vectors. prediction_braking uses current actual_tension_n; local_comparison uses previous actual_tension_n and requires the exact adopted parameter/value and a saved effective plan horizon of 0.01 s. prediction_braking compares held recorded input with an instantaneous braking box solution and requires no adoption. Choose update_id >= 1, hypotheses, fixed conditions, metrics, acceptance criteria and work_limits (wall_s <= 300; prediction_evaluations=2 or local_solves=2). Host fixes model.gvs@1.0.0, implicit Euler, 0.002 s step and 0.01 s horizon. At most two successful reading turns, then select the check. Do not overextend a local probe to the entire settling failure. State local_question, competing hypotheses, discriminating_observations and unresolved questions. If hypotheses predict the same result, explicitly say this check cannot separate them. Select a question the stated capability can answer; no dominant-cause claim. Availability status applies to the entire inventory entry unless you supply update_ids (controller updates) or time_range_s (sampled backend motion). For a partially read entry, use queried and describe missing coverage, or explicitly scope a not_read/not_displayed declaration to the unread subset.

recommendations.rationale: The zero terminal/holding tip-speed weights and the late effective-horizon truncation are candidate contributors to the residual tip speed, but raw weights do not establish term importance. A saved-state check under saved_state_or_temporary_analysis scope (local_comparison with exactly one adopted weight change, or prediction_braking at one saved projected state) could measure local endpoint speed/position differences, but it cannot establish closed-loop settling or a dominant cause; deferring pending explicit authorization.

Historical full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are reported not retained, so plan-selection/warm-start and objective-weighting effects cannot be separated from the current record. Retaining per-iteration objective contributions, per-update effective horizon, policy_stop_reason and warm-start reuse for future runs would let those hypotheses be tested without a closed-loop counterfactual replay.

attribution.reason: Every sampled update overruns the 0.01 s control period (mean 17.0752 s) with 35 deadline misses, and the optimizer returns User_Requested_Stop in 34/35 updates with max_cpu_s 30.0 s, so accepted plans are budget-limited rather than converged. However, the recorded scheduling note states synchronous controller calls complete before fixed-count backend steps and wall deadline misses do not inject physical delay into simulated time, so wall-timing degradation alone does not explain the residual tip speed; this remains possible, not established.

29 of 35 updates selected the initialization/seed plan versus 6 non-initialization selections, the effective horizon shrinks to 2 and 1 control intervals near the end versus configured horizon 10, and warm-state regeneration is enabled with feasible_return budget_s 15.0 / relative_improvement 0.1. Seed-dominated, horizon-truncated plans could carry limited terminal braking authority, but no historical optimizer iterations or full warm plans are retained to confirm it.

terminal_tip_speed_weight, holding_tip_speed_weight and holding_brake_lead_s are recorded as 0.0 with velocity_weight and terminal_velocity_weight at 1e-4 and tip_speed_scale_m_s 0.02, so apart from the terminal position weight the recorded objective has no explicit terminal-speed penalty. Raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions/scaling, so this is possible, not supported.

The recorded scheduling note states synchronous controller calls complete before fixed-count backend steps and wall deadline misses do not inject physical delay into simulated time, so the reported 17.0752 s mean update and 35 deadline misses are not themselves a mechanism that slows the simulated tip.

Recorded limitations state that no historical optimizer iterations or full warm plans are reconstructed and that single execution and model comparisons do not establish a dominant cause; the retained signals do not separate the candidate explanations.

facts.statement: Late-window tip motion exceeds the recorded settling limits (position 0.01 m, speed 0.02 m/s over a 0.05 s window): sampled tip error peaked at 0.05814 m and speed at 1.58102 m/s near t=0.30-0.33 s and decayed monotonically to 0.01007 m at 0.77581 m/s (t=0.34 s) and 0.00764 m at 0.63517 m/s (t=0.35 s), never approaching the 0.02 m/s limit, while reach is recorded as passed with a 0.01 m tolerance and the same 0.00764 m terminal error.

Controller-update wall timing far exceeds the control period and the optimizer almost never returns a convergent status: mean update 17.0752 s versus control_period_s 0.01 s over 35 updates, 35 deadline misses recorded, max_cpu_s 30.0 s, and raw solver status User_Requested_Stop in 34 of 35 updates versus Solve_Succeeded in 1.

Plan selection is initialization/seed-heavy and the effective horizon truncates well below the configured horizon: initialization_selected 29 versus noninitialization_selected 6, effective_horizon 2 control intervals at update 33 and 1 at update 34 against configured horizon 10, with regenerate_warm_states true and feasible_return budget_s 15.0 / relative_improvement 0.1.

The recorded objective carries zero terminal and holding tip-speed weighting: terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0, holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0, holding_brake_lead_s 0.0, with velocity_weight 1e-4, terminal_velocity_weight 1e-4, tip_speed_scale_m_s 0.02.
